title: Samsung Electronics listing information
excerpt: Samsung lists preferred shares as KRX 005935 / ISIN KR7005931001 and the preferred GDR as LSE SMSEL / ISIN US7960502018; 815,974,664 preferred shares were outstanding at Q1 2026.
summary: Issuer listing information verifies that the maintained security is the preferred-share GDR, distinct from Samsung's common shares and common GDR, and provides the preferred underlying and LSE GDR identities.
